🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 18, 2026

Sun, in its fall in Libra, holds a square to Moon, in detriment in Capricorn. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Saturn and Neptune have just closed a conjunction, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. Four weeks of Cancer ended, and nothing carried over.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Capricorn, meeting no resistance. Fixed earth: nothing needs letting go of today. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Libra, Sun concedes the point early. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. Four weeks ago Mercury was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you, exiled in Capricorn. Sun in Libra presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Water opens the file, and the file has a price. The square to Pluto that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Libra, without leverage of its own. Mars is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fixed fire: the holding and the held stop differing. The Virgo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Capricorn, and the ease asks its own attention. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. The hold Venus had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Sun occupies your sign: what you own is at hand, not in theory. Air starts and settles in the same breath. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon sextiles you from Capricorn: a door left ajar. Water keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. A week ago Mars was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Libra, Sun makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. What pressed three weeks ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Earth begins and is billed in the same gesture. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you and is weak in Aries: the grip tightens too soon. Sun in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Air keeps what it has, cheaply. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. From Capricorn, Moon hands you an opening. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
